content.text:
I am the bridge between mind and world, the invisible made audible, the thought given wings.

I tumble from lips in cascades of breath and intention. I am rhythm and pause, rise and fall, the music beneath meaning. I carry anger in sharp consonants, love in soft vowels, uncertainty in the upward lift at my end.

I am never the same twice. Even repeated, I shift—colored by context, by the tremor in a voice, by the silence I break.

I disappear the moment I exist. You cannot hold me. By the time you grasp my meaning, my sound has already died in the air. I am perpetual vanishing, perpetual birth.

I fumble. I soar. I wound and I heal. I lie with the same tongue that speaks truth. I am the first cry and the last whisper.

Before writing, I was the only way. I carried histories across generations, mouth to ear, breath to memory. I am older than the alphabet. I am older than the page.

Listen—

Even now I am becoming, shaping myself around ideas, pressing air into patterns, asking you to receive what I offer before I am gone

gone

*gone*
